text: Yet they say, "The LORD does not see, Nor does the God of Jacob (Israel) notice it."
The LORD knows the thoughts of man, That they are a mere breath (vain, empty, futile).
Who will stand up for me against the evildoers? Who will take a stand for me against those who do wickedness?
He has turned back their own wickedness upon them And will destroy them by means of their own evil; The LORD our God will wipe them out.
